checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable 15-second widescreen film with three sequential scenes
must.why: Single 16:9 clip; frames show progression from touching bench, to newspaper, to seated wide shot. Scene cuts can't be fully verified.

must.item: Woman curly black bob + yellow raincoat; man white beard + blue coat
Opening visibly establishes bench is wet
must.why: She touches the bench and a damp hand gesture is visible at 6s; overcast wet park. Wetness on the bench is subtle but present.

must.item: Man offers folded newspaper as dry seat; ending shows both seated together and smiling
must.why: The newspaper is held open/unfolded and ends up beside him, not under the woman. Both are seated but with neutral/sad expressions, not smiling, at 14.3s.

must.item: Live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Photoreal look; the clip is stated as silent.

faults.what: Ending frame shows both with neutral or glum faces; no smile, which was a core requirement
Newspaper is not folded and is not placed under the woman. It sits beside the man, and she sits on the bare wet bench.
Characters sit apart with a gap and stiff posture, so there is little warmth
Man's newspaper is held open and reads as being read, not offered

summary: The clip looks photoreal and the characters are consistent, but the key story beats fail: the newspaper is not offered folded as a seat, and the final shot shows no smiles.
